hard_constraints: deployable_array requires ADCS sun-pointing support when integration.requires contains sun_pointing_adcs
primary_battery is not valid for long-duration rechargeable LEO missions unless mission.mode == backup_or_short_life
recommended_selection_groups: Select one or more power_generation items.
Select one energy_storage item for rechargeable missions.
Select one pdu if payload has multiple switched loads or protection requirements.
Select bms when battery product does not include internal battery management.
Select sada only when deployable/rotating solar array architecture is chosen.
